members.concept_prompt: Wide 16:9 three-panel 2D anime character concept design sheet on a seamless solid warm ivory-cream studio background (#F7EFE6), with NO divider lines, NO borders, NO text, NO labels, and NO watermark. Left panel: full-body standing figure from head to sandals. Center panel: large front-facing chest-up portrait. Right panel: medium pure left-facing side-profile bust portrait. Character: Jiafa (Gui Xiao), a 24-year-old dignified handsome young noble and earnest social-politics minister, 175cm. Lustrous straight waist-length jet-black hair neatly tied in a low ponytail with long refined framing side locks. Clear earnest dark phoenix eyes, dead-serious upright composed expression, clean closed lips with no visible teeth. Wearing a slim-tailored deep indigo-blue traditional kimono haori coat with crisp white collar and hem trim over a snow-white inner kimono, pleated black hakama trousers, white tabi socks, and traditional zori sandals. In the full-body view his hands rest solemnly near his wide sleeves while a small cute vintage round black iron sphere with a tiny sparking fuse (symbolic knowledge bomb) and a tied crimson scroll peek subtly from his sleeve. Masterful 2D Japanese anime production art, Kyoto Animation aesthetic, crisp delicate lineart, soft matte cel-shading, clean uncluttered fabric folds, bright soft neutral studio lighting, pure 2D illustration, no 3D CGI, no plastic glossy sheen.

Luminous pale champagne-blonde hair neatly styled in an elegant high updo secured by a slender celadon-jade bookmark hairpin, with soft parted side bangs. Clear calm lake-blue eyes behind delicate thin gold half-rim eyeglasses, serene composed expression, gentle closed lips with no visible teeth. In the full-body view she holds two neatly bound leather-trimmed archival books and a small jade index tally tablet cleanly against her arm. Masterful 2D Japanese anime production art, Kyoto Animation aesthetic, crisp delicate lineart, soft matte cel-shading, clean uncluttered fabric folds, bright soft neutral studio lighting, pure 2D illustration, no 3D CGI, no plastic glossy sheen.
